title: Tenant KMS Allowlist, Residency Diagnoser, and RBAC Drift Exporter
author: Priya Rao
release_notes: Add tenant-scoped KMS allowlist enforcement, a residency diagnoser endpoint for troubleshooting region-pin decisions, and an RBAC v1->v2 drift export tool; no breaking changes to public API; rollout gated behind feature flags.
description: Motivation: several enterprise customers requested a deterministic way to ensure tenant KMS usage is constrained to an allowlist of provider accounts/regions, plus on-demand tooling to explain residency decisions and to audit RBAC differences between v1 and v2. This PR implements three coordinated pieces: 1) a tenant-scoped KMS allowlist enforced inside the policy evaluator with explicit audit tags (kms.allowlist_status), 2) an internal residency diagnoser HTTP endpoint (/internal/v1/residency-diagnose) that returns a structured reason code and suggestion string for why a request was routed to a particular region or fallback, and 3) a CLI and server-side exporter that emits RBAC "drift" snapshots to help migrations (redwood rbac export-drift --since=<ts>). Design notes: the allowlist is represented as a namespaced config object reconciled by the operator and cached in the policy evaluator; enforcement is a soft-fail by default (audit-only) and switchable to deny via the feature flag feature.kms.tenant_allowlist.enforce. The residency diagnoser borrows the routing decision graph used by the smart router and runs a deterministic explain pass that avoids any non-idempotent side-effects. RBAC drift exporter snapshots are output as compressed ndjson and include binding diffs, policy fingerprints, and a short provenance header for audit ingestion. Commits (high level): - initial allowlist schema + operator sync (pkg/kms/allowlist, operator/allowlist_controller) - policy evaluator checks + audit enrichment (pkg/policy/evaluator, pkg/audit/enricher) - residency diagnoser service and small RT explain engine (services/residency/diagnoser) - rbac drift exporter CLI + server endpoint (cmd/rwctl rbac export-drift, api/admin/rbac_export) - e2e and unit tests + installer smoke for private deployments - docs and release note. Changed areas: operator/allowlist_controller.go, pkg/kms/allowlist.go, pkg/policy/evaluator/allowlist_check.go, pkg/audit/enricher/allowlist_tags.go, services/residency/diagnoser.go, cmd/rwctl/rbac_export.go, api/admin/rbac_export_handler.go, test/e2e/installer/residency_diagnose_test.go, docs/security/tenant-kms-allowlist.md. Testing: unit tests for allowlist matcher (edge cases with multi-provider keys, region aliases), integration tests for policy evaluator that assert audit entries contain kms.allowlist_status, and an e2e installer smoke that verifies the diagnoser endpoint is reachable in private mode. Rollout plan: initial merge enables audit-only mode for all tenants; ops will enable feature flag to 10% of accounts for enforcement for two weeks while monitoring audit telemetry and residency diagnoser hits; full enforcement after SRE signoff. Backwards compatibility: the allowlist is additive and disabled by default for enforcement; RBAC drift exporter is read-only. Security review: interactive runbook and threat model (attached) were reviewed by security. Merge: squash merge to main after final approval. Related work: references ENG-9241 for rollout milestones and SUP-8810 for customer support tickets.
